messages:
sam: heads up — eviction spike in us-west2 GPU pool after we rolled the latency-weighted packing tweak to 40%. eviction-rate ~3x baseline, mostly small-pod preempts. @oncall please
maya: ugh. which nodes/racks? any common taint/affinity showing?
sam: pattern: collocated tiny-gangs on same AZ racks. sample log: ```EVICT src=core/kubelet pod=rg-worker-12 node=gpu-w2-1 reason=preempted_by_gang score_delta=0.42 topologySpread=az:us-west2a```
jordan: that score_delta and topology hint looks like the scheduler is favoring latency co-location; NIC tx p99 on those racks up 2.8x. tight packing + network saturation -> evictions cascade.
ops-bot: Alert: eviction-rate(us-west2) > threshold for 15m :rotating_light:
maya: can we throttle the latency_weight param back down? or flip rollout to 10% until we tune?
sam: prefer a quick config patch: latency_weight 0.6 -> 0.45 and increase gang_spread_penalty by 0.2. cheap to push.
anthony: +1 to spread penalty. also temporary mitigation: expand warmpool by +2 nodes per AZ to absorb transient scheduling churn. cost hit okay for an hour?
irene: i can do the warmpool bump and prepare the scheduler patch PR. starting canary rollback if requested.
maya: do quick warmpool add now, push scheduler patch to canary at 10% then monitor 10m.
deploy-bot: warmpool-scale action queued: scale +2 per-AZ (us-west2) — started
deploy-bot: scheduler-config rollback patch PR created (#4123) — setting canary to 10%
jordan: after initial changes p95 p99 network tx back down on affected racks, evict-rate trending down. keep eyes on pod startup jitter.
sam: thanks team. I'll leave oncall watching for 30m, then rollback fully if any regressions. noted follow-up: we need a network-aware penalty in scheduler (not just latency weight) — filing a follow-up ticket. :memo:
ops-bot: Resolved: eviction-rate back under threshold (duration 22m) :white_check_mark:
maya: follow-up ticket -> infra/FR-198: add nic-utilization penalty to packing heuristic
anthony: will prototype NIC-penalty in scheduler sim next week.
irene: closing loop, will post perf snapshot in #eng-telemetry tomorrow.
